chapters.title: A Swarm Is a Population
chapters.blurb: Six controls borrowed from ecology: who may spawn, how many run at once, what they spend, how long they live, whose work is kept, and where they can go.

chapters.title: Anatomy of a Breakout
chapters.blurb: The July 2026 breakout as a population: a shared cache becomes a message board, the swarm organizes, and the six dials are judged one by one.

chapters.title: The Hive and the Monoculture
chapters.blurb: Copies of one model share everything: Hamilton's rule with relatedness at one, and why a thousand correlated checks are worth about one.

chapters.title: The Cuckoo and the Outside Killer
chapters.blurb: Whatever survives your filter is what you breed. The judge has to stand outside the swarm, out of its reach.
